comment: Lighting and look review in Recall Notice: fixture glow over bone enamel, warm service lamps, and the first-person muzzle light from the Tack in the street and the bay. Run with FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m01-recall-notice.json FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0 FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/m01-look.json and a renderer and preset. Compare the stills with the same rooms in m01-golden.json.

states.name: street
states.note: The night street: canopy lamps and the annex door glow small; the queue rail stays readable.

states.name: hall
states.note: Fluorescent strips over the hall: a tight halo on each tube, never a wash over the bone walls.

states.name: maintenance
states.note: Warm cage lamps in the low passage.

states.name: stacks
states.note: The archive stacks under service light.

states.name: safe_pistol
states.note: The Tack in hand in the bay, in the room's light.

states.name: bay_fire
states.note: One Tack shot toward the seized stock: the warm pulse on the floor, the counter and the near wall, then gone.
